title: Narrow Flag, Wide Session
summary: Among NR4 sessions — the narrowest range of the trailing four, a flag the session earns itself — how often that same session's range nevertheless reached r times the prior 14-session ATR. The two yardsticks disagree by design: NR4 is relative to the last four sessions, ATR to the last fourteen, so a session can be locally narrowest yet still large in absolute terms after a wild stretch. The denominator is NR4 sessions with an ATR on record; the numerator is the ones clearing the threshold — and this is a same-session measurement, not a day-after expansion stat, which would need a next-session range outcome.

params.name: r
params.doc: Range threshold in multiples of the prior 14-session ATR.

deltas: makes the relative-vs-absolute volatility disagreement measurable instead of anecdotal
the range-vs-ATR distribution of flagged sessions is attached in full
